title: ICAI Introduces Online Facility for Voluntary Surrender of Exam Exemptions
content:
# ICAI Introduces Online Facility for Voluntary Surrender of Exam Exemptions

Ek important update hai for all CA students! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne exam exemptions ko voluntarily surrender karne ke liye ek naya online facility announce kiya hai. Yeh initiative July 30, 2026, ko announce kiya gaya hai.

Here are the key details:

*   **What is it?** ICAI ne ek online facility introduce ki hai jahan candidates apni previously obtained exam exemptions (including Permanent Exemptions) ko voluntarily surrender kar sakte hain.
*   **Why this move?** This step is part of ICAI's continuous efforts to make the examination process more accessible, transparent, and to streamline exam administration. It also aims to provide candidates with greater flexibility in managing their exemptions.
*   **How to surrender?** Candidates jo apni exemption surrender karna chahte hain, woh ICAI ke Self Service Portal (SSP) dashboard par "Exam Functions" section mein apne login credentials use karke yeh request submit kar sakte hain.
*   **Important Cut-off Dates:**
    *   **CA Intermediate (September 2026 Examination):** The last date to surrender exemptions is August 5, 2026.
    *   **CA Final (November 2026 Examination):** The last date to surrender exemptions is September 30, 2026.
*   This announcement was issued by CA. Anand Kumar Chaturvedi, Joint Secretary (Examinations).
